model.title: A resolution designating September 25, 2026, as "National Ataxia Awareness Day", and raising awareness of ataxia, ataxia research, and the search for a cure.

summary.text: The resolution would designate a specific date as National Ataxia Awareness Day and aims to increase public awareness of ataxia as a disease, along with efforts to research it and develop treatments.
